note: On US 50 in Penrose between Pueblo and Cañon City, about 15 min to Pueblo Reservoir and 25 to the Royal Gorge Bridge; convenience store and gas next door. No website of its own: its Colorado Vacation Directory listing (not the operator's site) pitches it as a 'long term, centralized base camp' with 40 full-hookup pull-through sites (36 of them 45 ft+), laundry and a group pavilion, open all year, and posts only monthly rates. --Claude
summary: No operator website or booking engine: Google Maps lists 'Floyd's RV Park', 1438 N St (US-50), Penrose, 3.9 stars from 65 reviews, phone 719-372-3385 (matches), with the coloradodirectory.com listing as its website. The only rate anywhere is the directory's monthly $500-550 for two (electric included); no nightly price. Cleared directory-only hookups (water/sewer), site count, pull-through, laundry and year-round season. Note: kept the directory description as such, dropped 'daily and monthly rates' (only monthly is posted). Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Great Sand Dunes NP 88 km); the family has not stayed here.
flags: Long-stay in character, fails long-stay test 2: the only description (coloradodirectory.com, the website Google Maps links) calls it 'your long term, centralized base camp' and posts only 'Monthly RV Site Rates (Electricity Included) On-Season : Range from $500.00 to $550.00 for two people'; no nightly rate is posted anywhere and there is no booking engine ('PHONE: 719-372-3385 -- For Current Rates and Availability'). The RV Life $$ tier does not stand in for a long-stay park. Candidate for removal.
Website is a directory listing (coloradodirectory.com); the operator has no website. Presence via Google Maps only: open listing, 3.9 stars / 65 reviews, phone 719-372-3385.
No 2024+ nightly rate from the operator; no gateway within 40 km, so the US$50 gate cannot be checked without a phone call.
